steps.title: Directory admin (web) — households: list, search, create/edit, photo, privacy toggles, head of house, leader notes
steps.goal: A directory administrator (any member holding `users.create` or `org.settings`) opens `/o/<slug>/directory`, searches the church's households, creates a household, edits its address/phone/anniversary, uploads a household photo to the `directory-photos` bucket, reads and writes the household's leader notes, designates the head of house, and flips the three privacy toggles (`hide_from_fellowship`, `hide_from_congregation`, `show_children_in_fellowship`) subject to the direction rule (admins only toward more privacy) with the family-confirmation state visible. Every read goes through the `directory_households` / `directory_persons` views and every write through the `save_household`, `set_household_privacy`, `save_leader_notes` and `save_person` RPCs. Persons CRUD, congregation status and account linking are step 5.1b.

Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, a member who holds `users.create` or `org.settings` (the "directory admin" mapping — PLAN §4: "directory admin = `users.create` or `org.settings`") sees a **Directory** entry in the org navigation and can: list and search households at `/o/<slug>/directory`; create a household at `/o/<slug>/directory/households/new`; open `/o/<slug>/directory/households/<householdId>` to edit name, address, home phone, anniversary and sort key, upload or replace the household photo, read/write the leader notes, designate the head of house among the household's adults, and change the three privacy toggles within the direction rule while seeing whether the family has confirmed its privacy choices. The household page also lists the household's persons (read-only cards linking to `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/<personId>`, a route that 5.1b creates — until then the link may 404). Lint, typecheck, unit tests, the web build and the Playwright smoke project are green.

## Inputs / prior state
- Steps 3.1–3.2b built the org shell: `apps/web/app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx`, `requireOrgMember(slug)` → `OrgContext = {org: {orgId, slug, name, status}, membershipStatus, personId, householdId, permissions, isSuperAdmin, writable}` (no user id lives on it — that is `getAuthContext()` → `AuthContext.userId` from 2.1a's `src/lib/auth/context.ts`; 2.1a/3.1 may spell the org id `org.orgId` or `org.org_id` — read `src/lib/auth/require-org.ts` and use the field that exists), `requirePerm(ctx, perm | perms[])` (array = any-of), `isWritable(ctx)` / `requireWritable(ctx)`, `src/features/org/nav.ts` (`NAV_ITEMS` with `requires?: PermissionKey[]` any-of), `src/lib/storage/signed-url.ts` (`getSignedUrl(bucket, path, expiresIn)` — add a sibling `getSignedUrls(bucket, paths, expiresIn)` built on `createSignedUrls` if absent), `src/lib/dates.ts` (`formatDateOnly`, `formatInstantInZone`; created by 3.5a, which promoted 3.3a's sermons date helpers), the `ActionResult` / `toActionError` Server Action convention, the logo upload pattern in `src/features/settings/*` (3.1: Server Action writes the planned path, browser uploads with the user client) and `/o/[orgSlug]/users?invite=<personId>` / `?create=<personId>` (3.2b) which 5.1b will link to. Web QA (3.7a/3.7b/3.8): the Playwright `smoke` project with the mock env and `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke`, `apps/web/e2e/helpers/headers.ts` (`expectStrictHeaders`), the env-gated `full` project with `e2e/full/01-acceptance.spec.ts` and `e2e/full/supabase-admin.ts`, `docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md`; 3.6b's cron orphan sweep (objects older than 24 h with no referencing row).
- `@church/db` (1.7a): `queries/directory.ts` — `searchHouseholds(orgId, { query, limit, offset })` from `directory_households` ordered by `sort_key, name` (1.7a's name — do not add a `listHouseholds` alias; it must filter `org_id = orgId` because the view also returns fellowship-visible households of other churches), `getHousehold(id)`, `listPersonsForHousehold(householdId)` from `directory_persons`, `getHouseholdWithPersons`, `getHouseholdLeaderNotes`, `getPersonLeaderNotes`, `getPrivacyState(householdId)` (masked `hide_from_fellowship`, `hide_from_congregation`, `show_children_in_fellowship`, `privacy_confirmed_at`, `view_level`); RPC wrappers `saveHousehold(db, { payload })` → uuid, `savePerson(db, { payload })` → uuid, `setHouseholdPrivacy(db, { hh, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children })`, `saveLeaderNotes(db, { kind, id, notes })`; `queryKeys.directory.households(orgId, query)`, `.directory.household(id)`, `.directory.persons(householdId)`; `unwrap*` helpers. The 1.7a test asserts the directory module never touches the `persons`/`households` base tables — keep that true.
- `@church/domain` (1.6a/1.6b): `saveHouseholdSchema` (keys `id?`, `org_id?`, `name`, `address_line1`, `address_line2`, `city`, `region`, `postal_code`, `country` default `US`, `home_phone`, `photo_path`, `anniversary`, `sort_key`), `savePersonSchema`, `setHouseholdPrivacySchema`, `householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, uuid)` → `{org_id}/households/{id}/{uuid}.jpg`, `BUCKETS`, `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`, `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS`, `toDomainError` / `DomainError`, `mapStorageErrorMessage`, error keys `invalid_payload`, `upload_mime_not_allowed`, `upload_too_large_for_plan`, `organization_suspended`.
- Database facts (`9999_init.sql`): `households (id, org_id, name, address_line1, address_line2, city, region, postal_code, country default 'US', home_phone, photo_path, anniversary, sort_key, hide_from_fellowship default false, hide_from_congregation default false, show_children_in_fellowship default false, privacy_confirmed_by, privacy_confirmed_at, created_via default 'admin')` with check `photo_path like org_id || '/households/' || id || '/%'`; `household_leader_notes (household_id pk, org_id, notes, updated_by, updated_at)`; `persons.household_role` enum `head | spouse | child | other` with the partial unique index "at most one `head` per household" (orchestrator decision 6). Views: `directory_households` exposes `anniversary_display` (`YYYY-MM-DD` for `admin`/`household` level, `MM-DD` for `congregation`), the privacy columns only at `admin`/`household` level, and `view_level`; `directory_persons` exposes `birthday_display`, `youth_override`/`member_since` (admin only) and `view_level`. Column-level grants: `select birthdate from persons` and `anniversary from households` fail with 42501 for `authenticated` — never select them from the base tables. Writes to `households`, `persons` and the notes tables are RPC-only. `save_household(payload jsonb)`: inserts require directory admin and `org_id` in the payload; unknown keys → `invalid_payload`; admin-created households get `hide_from_fellowship = true` ("Admin-created households get `hide_from_fellowship = true` by default"). `set_household_privacy(hh, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children)`: the `app.guard_household_privacy_columns` trigger enforces the direction rule (DESIGN §4.4: "household adults any direction (stamps `privacy_confirmed_*`), directory admins only toward more privacy, super admin any; audited"), which founder decision 1 extends to `hide_from_congregation`; a refused direction raises `privacy_direction_not_allowed` (42501) and a caller who is not a household editor gets `not_household_editor` (42501) — both keys are fixed by 1.3b's catalogue and exported from `@church/domain` `errors.ts`. `save_leader_notes(kind, id, notes)`: `kind in ('household','person')`, directory admin only. `save_person` by a directory admin may set any `household_role`.
- Founder decisions that apply: decision 1 — "Families may hide from their OWN congregation too → `households.hide_from_congregation` gets a real UI toggle (household adults any direction; org admins only toward more privacy; super admin any)" — this step ships that toggle for admins (DESIGN §9's "hidden in UI" sentence is superseded; say so in HANDOFF). Decision 2 — fellowship viewers see everything the congregation sees minus birth year, anniversary year and leader notes. HANDOFF "Decisions": "admin-entered households start hidden from the fellowship until a family adult confirms; leaders can only make a family *more* private". Decision 6 — one `head` per household; "Directory admins and household adults may set it (step 5.1 / 5.2)".

## Build
1. **Navigation and guard.** Add `{ href: 'directory', label: 'Directory', requires: ['users.create', 'org.settings'] }` to `NAV_ITEMS` (uncomment the placeholder if 3.1 left one; follow the href convention of the existing entries — 3.5a/3.5b use slug-relative `href: 'announcements'` / `'bulletins'` — so the active-item check and the slug join keep working). Create `src/lib/auth/require-directory-admin.ts` exporting `requireDirectoryAdmin(ctx)` = `requirePerm(ctx, ['users.create', 'org.settings'])` and `isDirectoryAdmin(ctx)`; every page and Server Action in this step calls `requireOrgMember(orgSlug)` then `requireDirectoryAdmin(ctx)`, and mutating actions also `requireWritable(ctx)` (suspended/cancelled churches are read-only; the 3.1 `StatusBanner` already explains why). Non-admin members who type the URL get the 3.1 403 page. The member-facing web directory (`(me)` routes) is optional in DESIGN §11 and is NOT built here.
2. **Households list** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/page.tsx` + `src/features/directory/HouseholdsPage.tsx`: server-rendered first page through `searchHouseholds(orgId, { query, limit: 50, offset })` (must filter `org_id = orgId` — `directory_households` also returns fellowship-visible households of other churches) with `?q=` and `?page=` search params (the query matches household name; add a `persons` name search by also calling `listPersons(orgId, { query })` and merging the matching persons' households — de-duplicate by household id). Columns: photo thumbnail — mint the whole page's thumbnails in ONE call with `supabase.storage.from('directory-photos').createSignedUrls(paths, SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS)` (add `getSignedUrls(bucket, paths, expiresIn)` beside `getSignedUrl` in `src/lib/storage/signed-url.ts` if absent; never 50 sequential `getSignedUrl('directory-photos', photo_path, SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS)` calls per request), cached with TanStack for `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` when rendered client-side, name, city/region, home phone, adults' first names (from `listPersonsForHousehold`, batched: one `directory_persons` query with `household_id in (...)` — add `listPersonsForHouseholds(householdIds)` to `queries/directory.ts` if 1.7a lacks it), privacy badges ("Hidden from fellowship", "Hidden from congregation", "Awaiting family confirmation" when `privacy_confirmed_at` is null), and a person count. Toolbar: search input (debounced, updates `?q=`), "New household" button, total count. Empty state: "No households yet — create the first one or import a CSV (step 5.7)". Pagination: previous/next with 50 per page.
3. **Create household** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/households/new/page.tsx` + `src/features/directory/HouseholdForm.tsx` (client, RHF + `zodResolver(saveHouseholdSchema)`): fields name (required), address_line1/2, city, region, postal_code, country (default `US`), home_phone, anniversary (date input; stored as ISO date), sort_key (helper: "Defaults to the last name; controls ordering in the directory" — prefill from the name on blur if empty). Server Action `createHouseholdAction(orgSlug, input)` in `src/features/directory/actions.ts`: `requireDirectoryAdmin`, `requireWritable`, parse with `saveHouseholdSchema`, set `org_id = ctx.org.orgId`, call `saveHousehold(db, { payload })`, `revalidatePath` the list, redirect to the household page. After creation show an info callout on the household page: "Because a leader created this household it starts hidden from the fellowship. A household adult confirms the privacy choices from the app (step 5.2b) — or you can leave it hidden." Optionally the form offers "Add the first person now" which links to `/directory/persons/new?household=<id>` (5.1b route; render the link, it is fine if it 404s until 5.1b).
4. **Household page** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/households/[householdId]/page.tsx` + `src/features/directory/HouseholdPage.tsx`: `getHouseholdWithPersons(householdId)`; `notFound()` when the view returns nothing (a household outside the org or invisible to the actor looks identical to a missing one — never leak existence), and ALSO `notFound()` when the returned row's `view_level !== 'admin'` — a directory admin always gets `admin` for own-org households, so anything else is a fellowship-visible row of another church in the same fellowship that this page must never edit (the RPCs would refuse anyway, but the editing surface and the masked values must not render). Edit mode prefills `anniversary` from `anniversary_display`, which is the full `YYYY-MM-DD` at `admin` level; never read `anniversary` from `households` (42501). Sections with ids for anchors: `#details` (the `HouseholdForm` in edit mode → `updateHouseholdAction(orgSlug, householdId, input)` which sends `{ id, ...fields }` to `saveHousehold`; never send `org_id` on update), `#photo`, `#people`, `#privacy`, `#notes`. Header: name, badges as in the list, `view_level` chip shown only in development builds.
5. **Photo upload** `src/features/directory/HouseholdPhoto.tsx` (client) + actions `prepareHouseholdPhotoAction(orgSlug, householdId, { contentType, size })` and `revertHouseholdPhotoAction(orgSlug, householdId, previousPath)`. Flow (DESIGN §6/§7: the storage insert policy requires "a row exists whose `photo_path` equals `name` exactly and the caller … `can_edit_household`"): the action validates `BUCKETS['directory-photos'].allowedMimeTypes.includes(contentType)` and `size <= BUCKETS['directory-photos'].fileSizeLimitBytes` (10 MiB; 1.6a's `BUCKETS` is keyed by bucket id with `.fileSizeLimitBytes` / `.allowedMimeTypes` copied from `9999_init.sql` section (10) and asserted by `limits.test.ts` — do NOT add a `DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES` constant or a hard-coded MIME list), computes `path = householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, crypto.randomUUID())` (keep the `.jpg` extension the helper produces — the client re-encodes to JPEG below, and the DB check only constrains the prefix anyway), calls `saveHousehold(db, { payload: { id: householdId, photo_path: path } })`, returns `{ path, previousPath }`. The browser then uploads with the user client: `supabase.storage.from('directory-photos').upload(path, blob, { contentType: 'image/jpeg', upsert: false, cacheControl: '3600' })` for the re-encoded Blob; only when the canvas fallback keeps the original file pass that file with `contentType: file.type` (a plain upload — 10 MiB does not need tus). On storage failure call `revertHouseholdPhotoAction` (sets `photo_path` back to `previousPath`) and show `mapStorageErrorMessage(error)`; on success invalidate `queryKeys.directory.household(id)` and show the new signed URL. Client-side: downscale with a canvas to max 1600 px on the long edge and re-encode as JPEG quality 0.85 before upload (keeps photos small and normalises HEIC-converted files); keep the original if canvas decoding fails. "Remove photo" = `saveHousehold({ id, photo_path: null })`. Old objects have no delete policy for `authenticated`; they become orphans that the 3.6b cron sweep (> 24 h) removes — write that in a code comment and in `docs/RLS.md`'s known consequences.
6. **People section** `#people`: cards from `directory_persons` for this household — photo, preferred/first + last name, `household_role` label (Head of house / Spouse / Child / Other), `congregation_status` badge, `birthday_display`, `directory_listed = false` → "Unlisted" badge, `deceased_on` → "Deceased" badge; each card links to `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/<id>` (5.1b). Buttons "Add person" → `/directory/persons/new?household=<id>` (5.1b). **Head of house** control (decision 6): a select listing the household's persons whose `household_role in ('head','spouse')` or for whom 1.6a's `isAdult(p, settings, asOf)` from `@church/domain` `audiences.ts` is true (`settings` = `getSettings(orgId)`, `asOf` = `todayInZone(settings.timezone)` from `@church/domain` `dates.ts`), current head preselected. Server Action `setHeadOfHouseAction(orgSlug, householdId, personId, previousHeadNewRole: 'spouse' | 'other')`: `requireDirectoryAdmin`, `requireWritable`; if another person is currently `head`, first `savePerson({ id: currentHead, household_role: previousHeadNewRole })`, then `savePerson({ id: personId, household_role: 'head' })`. Two RPC calls are not atomic — if the second fails, re-run the first with `household_role: 'head'` to restore, surface the error, and leave a `TODO(5.8): replace with the atomic set_head_of_house RPC (proposed follow-up migration)` comment. A `duplicate` (23505) `DomainError` from the partial index (if the demotion did not happen) must map to "This household already has a head of house" — 1.6b's `toDomainError` already maps 23505 to the `duplicate` key; add only the directory-specific message (additive, with a unit test).
7. **Privacy section** `#privacy` `src/features/directory/PrivacyPanel.tsx` (client) fed by `getPrivacyState(householdId)`: three switches with helper text — `hide_from_congregation`: "Hide this family from the congregation directory (they still see themselves)" (decision 1); `hide_from_fellowship`: "Hide this family from other churches in the fellowship"; `show_children_in_fellowship`: "Show this family's children to the fellowship (default: adults only)". Direction rule for admins: compute `allowedForAdmin(current, next)` in `src/features/directory/privacy-rules.ts` (pure, unit-tested) — an admin may set `hide_*` from false → true and `show_children_in_fellowship` from true → false, never the reverse; a super admin (`ctx.isSuperAdmin`) may do anything. Disabled switches carry the tooltip "Only a household adult can make the family less private (from the Anacast app)". Confirmation state: `privacy_confirmed_at` null → amber "Awaiting family confirmation — a household adult has not reviewed these settings yet"; otherwise "Confirmed <date>" in the org timezone. Server Action `setHouseholdPrivacyAction(orgSlug, householdId, flags)`: `requireDirectoryAdmin`, `requireWritable`, re-check `allowedForAdmin` server-side (belt and braces — the DB trigger is the real guard), call `setHouseholdPrivacy(db, { hh, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children })`; map `privacy_direction_not_allowed` (42501, raised by 1.3a's `app.guard_household_privacy_columns`; in `errors.ts`) to the tooltip sentence and `not_household_editor` (42501) to "You cannot edit this household" — write the mapping test up front with those two keys. Also show the org-level context: when `organization_settings.directory_share_with_fellowship` is false, a note "Your church does not share its directory with the fellowship (Settings → Directory), so the fellowship toggles have no effect today"; when `directory_share_in_congregation` is false, the same for the congregation toggle.
8. **Leader notes** `#notes` `src/features/directory/LeaderNotes.tsx` (client, reused by 5.1b with `kind='person'`): textarea prefilled from `getHouseholdLeaderNotes(householdId)`, "Save notes" → Server Action `saveLeaderNotesAction(orgSlug, kind, id, notes)` → `saveLeaderNotes(db, { kind, id, notes })`; shows `updated_at` and helper text "Visible only to directory administrators of this church. Never shown to the congregation, the fellowship or the audit log." Max 4000 characters — parse with 1.6b's `saveLeaderNotesSchema` (`kind: 'household' | 'person'`, `id`, `notes` ≤ 4000) from `@church/domain/schemas/directory.ts`; do not add a second schema.
9. **Queries and keys (additive only).** If `queries/directory.ts` lacks `listPersonsForHouseholds(householdIds)` or `countHouseholds(orgId, query)`, add them with explicit column lists from the views only; extend `queryKeys.directory` with `.count(orgId, query)` if used. Update `packages/db/README.md` accordingly. No SQL changes: if a needed RPC behaviour is missing (for example a non-directory-admin path), record it in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan" rather than editing `9999_init.sql` (frozen once pasted — check the ledger).
10. **Docs.** `docs/RLS.md`: add a "Directory admin UI (5.1a)" paragraph — which RPC each control calls, the direction rule as implemented, the orphaned-photo consequence, and that `hide_from_congregation` now has a UI (decision 1). Update `docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md` (3.8) with a short directory click-through: create household → upload photo → set head → toggle privacy toward private (works) → toward public (blocked with tooltip) → write leader notes.
11. **Tests.** Vitest: `privacy-rules.test.ts` (every transition × admin/super), `HouseholdForm` schema mapping (sort_key prefill, empty strings → null), `setHeadOfHouseAction` ordering with a mocked `@church/db` (demote → promote → restore on failure). Playwright smoke (`apps/web/e2e/directory.spec.ts`, `smoke` project, mock env from 3.7a): unauthenticated `/o/any/directory` redirects to `/login?next=…`; `/o/any/directory/households/new` likewise; the strict security headers hold on those URLs (`expectStrictHeaders`). Add an env-gated scenario to `e2e/full/01-acceptance.spec.ts` only if the 3.7b harness makes it a small addition (create household → appears in list → open it → set `hide_from_fellowship` on → the reverse is disabled); otherwise leave a `test.fixme` with those exact steps and write in HANDOFF that step 5.7 owns the directory Playwright + RLS-matrix coverage (PLAN §11: "add RLS tests for the directory matrix and Playwright coverage as UI lands").

## Constraints
- Reads only through `directory_households` / `directory_persons` / `org_directory_info` and the two leader-notes tables; never `select` from `persons` or `households` base tables (the 1.7a spy test enforces this in `@church/db` — keep web code on the query modules, no ad-hoc `.from('households')`). Writes only through the RPC wrappers; the service client is never used in this step.
- Every page and action: `requireOrgMember` → `requireDirectoryAdmin`; mutations also `requireWritable`. Server Actions receive `orgSlug` and never trust a client-supplied org id; `householdId`/`personId` are validated as uuids with Zod before use.
- Do not build persons CRUD, congregation status, account linking, CSV import, the member web directory or mobile screens (5.1b, 5.2a/5.2b, 5.7). Do not add columns, RPCs or policies; do not touch `supabase/migrations/`. Never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- Pins: Next 16.3, React 19.2.3, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, RHF + `zodResolver`, TanStack Query, Vitest 4, Playwright 1.62 — add no new dependency (canvas downscaling uses the browser API). No model identifiers in commits or files; no secrets; `<FOUNDER_EMAIL>`-style placeholders only.
- Neutral theme tokens from 2.1's `brand.ts`/`@theme` only; no hard-coded brand colours.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: feature table row "Directory (households, persons, photos, privacy override)" → Web UI "households done (5.1a), persons 5.1b"; State checklist Phase 2 line updated; under "Deviations from plan" record: DESIGN §9's "`hide_from_congregation` toggle hidden in UI" is superseded by founder decision 1; head-of-house is two `save_person` calls pending the atomic `set_head_of_house` RPC (proposed step 5.8); any additive `@church/db`/`@church/domain` helpers you introduced (names).
- Tick step 5.1a in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(web): directory admin — households list, search, create/edit, photo, privacy, head of house, leader notes`; push `main` (or the branch I named).
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong (for example `save_person` refusing `household_role = 'head'` for admins, or the direction-rule error key differing from the catalogue), do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.
done_when: A member holding `users.create` or `org.settings` sees a Directory item in the org navigation; a member without either gets the 403 page on `/o/<slug>/directory` and every `/directory/*` URL.

`/o/<slug>/directory` lists households from `directory_households` with search (`?q=` matches household and person names), 50-per-page pagination, photo thumbnails via signed URLs, privacy badges and an 'Awaiting family confirmation' badge when `privacy_confirmed_at` is null.

`/o/<slug>/directory/households/new` creates a household through `save_household` (with `org_id`), redirects to the household page, and the new household has `hide_from_fellowship = true` and `created_via = 'admin'`.

The household page edits details through `save_household({id, …})` (anniversary prefilled from `anniversary_display`), uploads a JPEG/PNG/WebP within `BUCKETS['directory-photos']` limits (10 MiB) to `directory-photos` at `householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, uuid)` only after the row's `photo_path` was set by the RPC, reverts the path when the upload fails, and 'Remove photo' nulls the path; list thumbnails are minted with one `createSignedUrls` call per page.

Opening `/o/<slug>/directory/households/<id>` for a household of another church in the same fellowship (a `directory_households` row with `view_level <> 'admin'`) returns the 404 page, and the list never shows other churches' households.

Privacy switches call `set_household_privacy`; for a directory admin only transitions toward more privacy are enabled (hide_* false→true, show_children true→false), the reverse is disabled with the tooltip, a super admin may do either, `privacy_direction_not_allowed` / `not_household_editor` are mapped to readable text, and `privacy-rules.test.ts` covers every transition.

Leader notes load from `household_leader_notes` and save through `save_leader_notes('household', id, notes)` with a 4000-character limit; a non-admin member cannot read them (RLS) and the UI states they are never shared.

steps.goal: A directory administrator adds people to a household and edits them at `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/new?household=<id>` and `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/<personId>`: names, sex, birthdate with its visibility, marital status, household role, `directory_listed`, `deceased_on`, contact fields and a person photo through `save_person`; sets `congregation_status` and `member_since` through `set_congregation_status`; overrides youth membership (`youth_override`); writes person leader notes; links or unlinks the person to a user account (`save_person` with `user_id`, never for a minor) and jumps to the 3.2b Invite / Create-account dialogs with the person preselected; deletes a person through `delete_person`. steps.prompt:
You are working in the ChurchAppCLD repository. CLAUDE.md loads `new_session_instructions.md` and `HANDOFF.md` automatically — follow the session-start checklist (new-session.sh, prompt_history.txt). Work on `main` unless I have named another branch in this session. This is step 5.1b "Directory admin (web) — persons: create/edit/delete, congregation status, contacts, photo, account linking, person leader notes" of `docs/TODO.md`; read that step's 'Done when' list first. Read `docs/PLAN.md` §4 (Directory tables, "Derivation", Client RPCs `save_person` / `delete_person` / `set_congregation_status` / `save_leader_notes`, permission mapping), §5, §6 (`directory-photos`), §8 and §11 item (1), and `docs/DESIGN.md` §4.2 (`persons`, `person_leader_notes`), §4.3 (derivation rules — the "role `other` and no birthdate" badge), §4.4 section (6) (`directory_persons` view), §5 ("Getting accounts" paths 2–3, household self-service paragraph), §6 (persons / leader-notes / storage rows) and §7 before writing code. Also read the bodies of `save_person`, `delete_person`, `set_congregation_status`, `app.guard_persons_columns`, `app.is_minor` / `app.is_adult` and `app.person_in_kind` in `supabase/migrations/9999_init.sql`, and the 5.1a code under `apps/web/src/features/directory/`. Build ONLY this step; do not start the next one.

## Goal
When you finish, the household page's "Add person" button and person cards (5.1a) lead to working pages: `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/new?household=<householdId>` creates a person in that household and `/o/<slug>/directory/persons/<personId>` edits everything a directory admin may edit, shows derived group badges, manages the person's photo and leader notes, sets congregation status, links/unlinks a user account with the COPPA guard, hands off to the 3.2b dialogs (`/users?invite=<personId>`, `/users?create=<personId>`), and deletes the person. Members without `users.create`/`org.settings` get 403. Lint, typecheck, unit tests, the web build and the Playwright smoke project are green.

## Inputs / prior state
- 5.1a: `requireDirectoryAdmin(ctx)`, `src/features/directory/{HouseholdsPage,HouseholdForm,HouseholdPage,HouseholdPhoto,PrivacyPanel,LeaderNotes,privacy-rules,actions}.tsx|ts`, the photo flow (Server Action sets the planned path through the RPC → browser uploads with the user client → revert on failure), `docs/RLS.md` "Directory admin UI" paragraph, `apps/web/e2e/directory.spec.ts`.
- 3.2a/3.2b: `listMemberships(orgId)` returns memberships enriched with `person: {id, first_name, last_name, preferred_name, household_id} | null`; `/o/[orgSlug]/users?invite=<personId>` opens the Invite dialog and `?create=<personId>` the Create-account dialog with the person preselected; `listLinkablePersons` (3.2b) lists persons without a `user_id`; `/users/[membershipId]` is the membership detail page.
- `@church/db` (1.7a): `getPerson(id)`, `listPersonsForHousehold(householdId)`, `getPersonLeaderNotes(personId)`, RPC wrappers `savePerson(db, { payload })` → uuid, `deletePerson(db, { person_id })`, `setCongregationStatus(db, { person_id, status, member_since })`, `saveLeaderNotes(db, { kind: 'person', id, notes })`; `getSettings(orgId)` (settings module) for the age thresholds and timezone; `queryKeys.directory.persons(householdId)`, `.directory.household(id)` — add `.directory.person(id)` if missing.
- `@church/domain`: `savePersonSchema` (keys `id?`, `org_id?`, `household_id`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `preferred_name`, `sex`, `birthdate`, `birthdate_visibility`, `marital_status`, `household_role`, `congregation_status`, `member_since`, `youth_override`, `directory_listed`, `email`, `mobile_phone`, `work_phone`, `photo_path`, `deceased_on`, `user_id`), `personPhotoPath(orgId, personId, uuid)` → `{org_id}/persons/{id}/{uuid}.jpg`, `audiences.ts` (1.6a — the pure mirror of `app.person_in_kind`; exports are fixed, use them by name): `personInKind(p, kind, ctx)` with `AudienceContext = { settings, asOf?, customMemberIds? }`, `isMinor(p, settings, asOf)` (= `household_role === 'child' || (birthdate !== null && age < adult_min_age)`), `isAdult(p, settings, asOf)` (= role head/spouse or age ≥ `adult_min_age`), `isYouth(p, settings, asOf)`; `dates.ts` (`todayInZone(tz, now)`, `ageOn(birthdate, asOf)`); `errors.ts` keys `household_role_not_allowed` (P0001), `field_not_editable` (42501, column name in `detail`), `minor_cannot_have_account` (P0001 — the COPPA key raised by `app.guard_persons_columns` when `user_id` is set on a minor), `duplicate` (23505 — the partial unique index `(org_id, user_id)` when the user is already linked to another person), `invalid_payload`, `organization_suspended`. All of these are in 1.3b's catalogue and 1.6a's `errors.ts`; write the mapping tests against these exact names.
- Database facts: `persons (id, org_id, household_id not null, user_id null, first_name, last_name, preferred_name, sex, birthdate, birthdate_visibility default 'month_day', marital_status default 'unknown', household_role default 'other', congregation_status default 'attendee', member_since, youth_override, directory_listed default true, email citext, mobile_phone, work_phone, photo_path, deceased_on)`; partial unique `(org_id, user_id) where user_id is not null`; photo check `photo_path like org_id || '/persons/' || id || '/%'`; enums `sex (male, female)`, `marital_status (unknown, single, married, widowed, divorced)` (1.2's values), `household_role (head, spouse, child, other)`, `birthdate_visibility (full, month_day, hidden)`, `congregation_status (member, attendee, inactive)`. `save_person` (1.3b): directory admins may set every key; "cannot link a `user_id` to a minor (COPPA)"; `set_congregation_status(person_id, status, member_since)` is admin-only; `delete_person(id)` — read its body for what happens to a linked user (expect: refused or unlinks first) and for the last person of a household. The `directory_persons` view returns `birthdate` and `birthday_display` in full, `youth_override` and `member_since` only at `admin` level; `select birthdate from persons` fails with 42501 — read only from the view. Column-level audit: `persons` status/link columns are audit-logged (DESIGN §4.2), leader notes never. `delete_person(person_id)` per 1.3b: directory admin, or a household adult when the person is not linked to a user — read the body for what it does with a linked `user_id` (refuse vs unlink) and with the person's photo object.
- PLAN §4 "Derivation": `is_minor = role child or age < adult_min_age`; `is_adult = role head/spouse or age ≥ adult_min_age`; `youth = coalesce(youth_override, age in [youth_min, youth_max] and (not youth_excludes_married or not married))`; `men/women = sex ∧ not minor ∧ (adult_groups_include_youth or not youth)`; base = `congregation_status in ('member','attendee') and deceased_on is null`; age in the org timezone. DESIGN §4.3: "A person with role `other` and no birthdate is neither [minor nor adult] (UI badge 'add birthdate or role'; excluded from fellowship view)" — note the consequence for account linking: `app.is_minor` is false for such a person, so the DB ALLOWS linking a user to them; only the UI decides how to present that (Build 6).
- Founder decision 3: "Each church sets its own youth age" — thresholds come from `organization_settings`, never constants. Decision 6: one `head` per household (5.1a's head-of-house control; this step's role select must not create a second head).

## Build
1. **Person form** `src/features/directory/PersonForm.tsx` (client, RHF + `zodResolver(savePersonSchema)` minus the admin-only keys handled by dedicated controls): first_name*, last_name*, preferred_name, sex (Male / Female / not set), birthdate (date input) + `birthdate_visibility` radio ("Full date — congregation sees the year", "Month and day only" (default), "Hidden") with helper "The fellowship never sees years regardless of this setting" (decision 2); marital_status select from the enum; `household_role` select (Head of house / Spouse / Child / Other) — if the household already has a `head` and the admin picks Head here, block with "Use 'Set head of house' on the household page" (link) so the partial unique index never fires; `directory_listed` switch ("Unlisted people never appear to the congregation or fellowship; admins and the household still see them"); `deceased_on` date (collapsed under "More"); contacts: email, mobile_phone, work_phone (light normalisation: trim, keep digits/+ for phones; Zod already validates email). Empty strings become `null`. Server Actions in `src/features/directory/person-actions.ts`: `createPersonAction(orgSlug, householdId, input)` (`requireDirectoryAdmin`, `requireWritable`, `household_id` from the route param validated as uuid, `org_id = ctx.org.orgId`, `savePerson(db, { payload })`, redirect to the person page) and `updatePersonAction(orgSlug, personId, input)` (`{ id, ...fields }` — never `org_id`/`household_id` on update unless the admin uses the explicit "Move to another household" control below).
2. **Routes.** `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/persons/new/page.tsx` — requires `?household=<uuid>`; loads the household via `getHousehold` (404 when invisible) and renders `PersonForm` under the heading "Add a person to <household name>". `app/(org)/o/[orgSlug]/directory/persons/[personId]/page.tsx` + `src/features/directory/PersonPage.tsx` — `getPerson(personId)` from `directory_persons` (404 when missing/invisible; also 404 when `view_level !== 'admin'` — a directory admin always gets `admin` for own-org persons, so anything else means a fellowship row that must not be edited here). Sections with anchors: `#details` (PersonForm in edit mode), `#status` (congregation status), `#groups` (derived badges), `#photo`, `#account`, `#notes`, `#danger` (move/delete). Breadcrumb: Directory → household name → person.
3. **Congregation status** `src/features/directory/CongregationStatus.tsx`: radio Member / Attendee / Inactive with `member_since` date shown when Member (prefilled from the view's `member_since`); Server Action `setCongregationStatusAction(orgSlug, personId, status, member_since)` → `setCongregationStatus(db, { person_id, status, member_since })`. Helper text: "Inactive people stay in the directory for leaders but are hidden from the congregation, the fellowship and every audience group" (base predicate). The `@church/domain` `SYSTEM_AUDIENCE_GROUPS` labels are: All attendees = everyone who attends, members included (HANDOFF decision).
4. **Derived groups panel** `src/features/directory/DerivedGroups.tsx` (server component): load `getSettings(orgId)` and compute with `personInKind(p, kind, { settings, asOf })` / `isMinor` / `isAdult` / `isYouth` from `@church/domain` `audiences.ts` for `asOf = todayInZone(settings.timezone)`: badges Youth / Men / Women / Members / Attendees, grey when not in the kind; the "add birthdate or role" amber badge when `household_role = 'other'` and `birthdate` is null (DESIGN §4.3); "Excluded: deceased" / "Excluded: inactive" when the base predicate fails. **Youth override** control (`youth_override`: Automatic / Always youth / Never youth) → `updatePersonAction` with `youth_override: null | true | false`; helper: "Automatic uses the church's youth ages (<youth_min_age>–<youth_max_age>, married excluded: <yes/no>) from Settings". Add a Vitest that renders the panel's pure helper (`deriveBadges(person, settings, asOf)` in `src/features/directory/derive-badges.ts`) against three fixtures from `packages/domain/fixtures/persons.json` so UI and SQL agree.
5. **Photo** — reuse 5.1a's component generalised to `DirectoryPhoto` with `kind: 'household' | 'person'`: for persons the prepare action calls `savePerson({ id, photo_path: personPhotoPath(orgId, personId, uuid) })`, uploads to `directory-photos` within `BUCKETS['directory-photos'].fileSizeLimitBytes` (10 MiB) and `.allowedMimeTypes` (client-side downscale and JPEG re-encode as in 5.1a; no new constant), reverts on failure; "Remove photo" nulls the path. Refactor 5.1a's `HouseholdPhoto` to the shared component (keep its tests passing).
6. **Account section** `src/features/directory/AccountLink.tsx`: four states, chosen by a pure `accountLinkState(person, settings, asOf)` in `src/features/directory/account-link-state.ts` returning `'linked' | 'adult' | 'minor' | 'unknown_age'`. (a) Linked — `user_id` present: show the membership (find it in `listMemberships(orgId)` by `user_id`; link to `/o/<slug>/users/<membershipId>`; status badge) and "Unlink account" → `updatePersonAction({ id, user_id: null })` with a confirm dialog ("The person stays in the directory; the account keeps its access to the church until you disable it under Users"). (b) `adult` — not linked and `isAdult(person, settings, asOf)` is true: buttons "Invite by email" → `/o/<slug>/users?invite=<personId>` (3.2b preselects the person and prefills the display name from `listLinkablePersons`; pass `&email=<encoded>` only if the Invite dialog already accepts such a param — otherwise leave it and do not modify 3.2b), "Create account" → `/o/<slug>/users?create=<personId>`, and "Link existing user": a picker of active memberships whose `person` is null (from `listMemberships`) → `updatePersonAction({ id, user_id })`; the partial unique index refuses a user already linked to another person in this org — map the `duplicate` (23505) `DomainError` to "That account is already linked to <name>" (find the name via `listMemberships`). (c) `minor` — `isMinor(person, settings, asOf)` is true (role `child`, or birthdate present and age < `adult_min_age`): the section reads "Accounts cannot be linked to minors (COPPA). Add a birthdate or set the role to Head/Spouse/Other adult first"; the DB refuses too — map `minor_cannot_have_account` (P0001) to the same sentence if it is forced. (d) `unknown_age` — role `other` with no birthdate (DESIGN §4.3: neither minor nor adult): show the amber "Add a birthdate or role to place this person in audience groups" badge and STILL offer the three linking actions, because `app.is_minor` is false for this person and the database allows the link — the UI must not be stricter than the DB here; say so in a code comment and in `docs/RLS.md`. Map `field_not_editable` (42501) — impossible for an admin, but surface it generically — to "You may not change that field".
7. **Move and delete** `#danger`: "Move to another household" — a household picker (search via 1.7a's `searchHouseholds(orgId, { query, limit: 20, offset: 0 })`) → `updatePersonAction({ id, household_id })`; if this person is the household's `head`, warn that the old household will have no head. "Delete person" → confirm dialog naming the consequences from `delete_person`'s body (read it: whether it refuses when `user_id` is set — if so the UI says "Unlink the account first" and disables the button while linked; whether it deletes the person's photo via `storage_deletions` — if not, note the 3.6b orphan sweep). Server Action `deletePersonAction(orgSlug, personId)` → `deletePerson(db, { person_id })` → redirect to the household page. Refuse in the UI to delete the last person of a household? No — allow it (a household may be empty while being set up), but show "This household will have no people".
8. **Person leader notes** `#notes`: 5.1a's `LeaderNotes` with `kind='person'` fed by `getPersonLeaderNotes(personId)` → `saveLeaderNotes(db, { kind: 'person', id, notes })`.
9. **Household page hooks** (5.1a files, small edits only): the person cards now link to real pages; "Add person" links to `/directory/persons/new?household=<id>`; after any person mutation `revalidatePath` both the person page and the household page.
10. **Queries (additive only).** If missing in `@church/db`: `queries/directory.ts` `getPerson(id)` returning every `directory_persons` column with an explicit list; `queryKeys.directory.person(id)`; a `findMembershipByUserId(orgId, userId)` in `queries/memberships.ts` only if `listMemberships` is too heavy for the account section (prefer reusing `listMemberships`). No `select *`, no base-table reads, no embeds of `profiles(`.
11. **Docs and tests.** `docs/RLS.md`: extend the "Directory admin UI" paragraph with persons (which control calls which RPC; the COPPA rule; the `other` + no birthdate badge; that `delete_person` is the only delete path). `docs/ACCEPTANCE_WEB.md`: add person → set status Member with `member_since` → badges update → link to an existing user → unlink → delete. Vitest: `derive-badges.test.ts` (fixtures), `PersonForm` empty-string→null mapping and the "second head" block, `accountLinkState(person, settings, asOf)` for all four states (linked / adult / minor / unknown_age — the child fixture, an adult fixture, the `other`-without-birthdate fixture from `persons.json`), and the error-key mapping (`minor_cannot_have_account`, `duplicate`, `field_not_editable`). Playwright smoke `apps/web/e2e/directory.spec.ts`: add unauth redirects for `/o/any/directory/persons/new?household=<uuid>` and `/o/any/directory/persons/<uuid>`. Playwright full (env-gated `full` project, `E2E_MODE=full`): extend `e2e/full/01-acceptance.spec.ts` with: create household → add an adult person → set status Member with `member_since` → Members badge shown → link to the E2E admin user → the Users grid shows the person → unlink → delete person. If the 3.7b harness cannot support it in one small addition, leave a `test.fixme` with these exact steps and write in HANDOFF that step 5.7 owns the directory Playwright + RLS-matrix coverage (PLAN §11).

## Constraints
- Directory admin guard on every page and action (`requireOrgMember` → `requireDirectoryAdmin`; mutations `requireWritable`). Reads only from `directory_persons` / `directory_households`; writes only via `save_person`, `delete_person`, `set_congregation_status`, `save_leader_notes`. Never select `birthdate` from `persons`. No service client.
- The admin `save_person` payload may contain any whitelisted key, but this UI never sends `congregation_status` / `member_since` through `save_person` — those go through `set_congregation_status` so the audit trail is uniform. Never send `org_id` on update.
- Do not build self-service (mobile, 5.2a/5.2b), CSV import (5.7), the member web directory, join requests (5.6) or any migration change. If `delete_person` or the COPPA rule behaves differently from the docs, follow the migration and record the deviation. Error keys come from 1.3b's catalogue via `@church/domain` `errors.ts` — never invent a key or match on message text. Never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- No new dependencies; pins as in 5.1a. No model identifiers, no secrets.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → all tasks succeed; the new Vitest files pass, including the fixture-driven `derive-badges.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter web build` → succeeds; routes `/o/[orgSlug]/directory/persons/new` and `/o/[orgSlug]/directory/persons/[personId]` are listed.
- `pnpm --filter web test:e2e:smoke` → green.
- `grep -rn "from('persons')\|from('households')\|birthdate" packages/db/src/queries/directory.ts` → the only `birthdate` hits are columns selected from `directory_persons`.
- Manual (hosted project): add a child (role Child, birthdate 8 years ago) → Account section shows the COPPA text; add a person with role Other and no birthdate → amber badge, linking still offered; set an adult to Member with `member_since` → Members badge on; toggle `youth_override` Always → Youth badge on regardless of age; link an existing unlinked user → the Users grid shows "first last · household" for that membership (3.2a); unlink → grid shows "Not linked"; delete the person → gone from the household page; as a plain member, `directory_persons` for that household shows no `member_since`/`youth_override` (null) and `birthday_display` without the year unless visibility is `full`.

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: feature table "Directory" Web UI → done (5.1a + 5.1b); State checklist; "Deviations from plan" for anything `delete_person`/COPPA-related you had to adapt and for additive helpers you added (names).
- Tick step 5.1b in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(web): directory admin — persons CRUD, congregation status, account linking, leader notes`; push `main` (or the branch I named).
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong, do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.

If they are a household adult (`household_role in ('head','spouse')` on their own person) they can edit household details, add and edit people within the non-admin rules, upload household and person photos as `ArrayBuffer` through `expo-image-picker` + `expo-image-manipulator`, choose the head of house, and open **Privacy** — an explainer plus three switches saved through `set_household_privacy`; a household created by a leader and never confirmed shows a "Review your family's directory privacy" banner on Home and on My household until an adult confirms, which stamps `privacy_confirmed_*`. A member who is not a household adult can still edit their own contact fields and sees the privacy switches read-only. `npx expo-doctor`, `npx expo export --platform android`, lint, typecheck and unit tests are green.

The household detail screen already renders an "Edit my household" button → `/household` for `view_level === 'household'` rows — this step makes that route exist.

Forms on mobile are Paper `TextInput`s as controlled inputs validated with the Zod schemas (`schema.safeParse`) — `react-hook-form` is NOT used on mobile and must not be added (4.1b rule). Already installed by 4.1a with `npx expo install`: `expo-file-system` (4.2a uses its `/legacy` API for bulletin downloads — do not mix the legacy and `File` APIs in one flow), `expo-sharing`, `expo-crypto` (`randomUUID()`), `expo-secure-store`, `expo-sqlite`.

- `@church/domain`: `saveHouseholdSchema` (keys `id?`, `org_id?`, `name`, `address_line1`, `address_line2`, `city`, `region`, `postal_code`, `country`, `home_phone`, `photo_path`, `anniversary`, `sort_key`), `savePersonSchema` (keys `id?`, `org_id?`, `household_id`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `preferred_name`, `sex`, `birthdate`, `birthdate_visibility`, `marital_status`, `household_role`, `congregation_status`, `member_since`, `youth_override`, `directory_listed`, `email`, `mobile_phone`, `work_phone`, `photo_path`, `deceased_on`, `user_id`), `setHouseholdPrivacySchema`, `householdPhotoPath(orgId, householdId, uuid)` → `{org_id}/households/{id}/{uuid}.jpg`, `personPhotoPath(orgId, personId, uuid)` → `{org_id}/persons/{id}/{uuid}.jpg`, `BUCKETS['directory-photos'].fileSizeLimitBytes` (10 MiB) and `.allowedMimeTypes` (1.6a — keyed by bucket id; no separate constant exists or may be added), `mapStorageErrorMessage`, `toDomainError`/`DomainError`, `audiences.ts` `isAdult`/`isMinor`, `dates.ts` `todayInZone`, `errors.ts` keys `household_role_not_allowed` (P0001), `field_not_editable` (42501), `not_household_editor` (42501), `privacy_direction_not_allowed` (42501), `minor_cannot_have_account` (P0001), `duplicate` (23505), `invalid_payload`, `organization_suspended` — all fixed by 1.3b's catalogue; map by key, never by message text. ## Build
1. **Dependencies** (mobile versions ONLY via `npx expo install`, run inside `apps/mobile`): `npx expo install expo-image-picker expo-image-manipulator` (both are in DESIGN §3's Mobile misc row; skip any already present — `expo-file-system`, `expo-sharing`, `expo-crypto` are already installed by 4.1a, do not reinstall). Add the `expo-image-picker` config plugin to `app.config.ts` with `photosPermission: "Anacast uses your photos to add a family or profile picture to the church directory."` and a similar `cameraPermission`. Record the installed versions in HANDOFF "Version pins worth remembering". No `react-native-*`/`expo-*` version literals typed by hand. A date picker: use masked `YYYY-MM-DD` text fields (no new module); install `@react-native-community/datetimepicker` via `npx expo install` only if 4.x already relies on one.
2. **Rules** `src/features/household/rules.ts` (pure, unit-tested): `canEditHousehold(ownPerson, orgStatus)` = `ownPerson.household_role in ('head','spouse') && orgStatus in ('trial','active','past_due')` (mirror of `app.can_edit_household` for a plain member; directory admins use the web); `isOwnRow(person, personId)`; `editableFieldsFor(person, ownPerson)` → `'all' | 'contacts' | 'none'` ('contacts' for the own row of a non-adult: `preferred_name, email, mobile_phone, work_phone, birthdate_visibility, photo_path`); `allowedRolesForNonAdmin` = `['child','other']`.
3. **My household** `app/(app)/household/index.tsx` (`src/features/household/MyHousehold.tsx`): from `useActiveOrg().householdId`; if null → `EmptyState` "You are not linked to a directory household yet — ask your church's directory administrator" (a `TODO(5.6)` comment for join requests). Otherwise `useHousehold(householdId)` with edit affordances when `canEditHousehold` is true; when the org is not writable show the read-only reason ("Your church's account is suspended; changes are disabled"). Rows: Details (→ `/household/edit`), People (each → `/household/person/<id>`; "Add a person" → `/household/person/new`), Photo (`PhotoPicker` for the household), Head of house (Build 6), Privacy (→ `/household/privacy`), and the confirmation banner (Build 8). A non-adult member's own row opens `/household/person/<id>` in "contacts only" mode; other rows are read-only for them.
4. **Edit household** `app/(app)/household/edit.tsx` (`src/features/household/HouseholdEdit.tsx`): Paper `TextInput`s as controlled inputs validated with `saveHouseholdSchema.safeParse` (the 4.1b pattern — no `react-hook-form`) for name, address lines, city, region, postal code, country, home phone, anniversary (masked `YYYY-MM-DD`, prefilled from `anniversary_display`, which is the full date at `household` level), sort key. Save → `saveHousehold(db, { payload: { id, ...fields } })` (never `org_id`; empty strings → null); invalidate `queryKeys.directory.household(id)` and `.directory.households(orgId, …)`; errors via `toDomainError` → friendly text (`organization_suspended` → the read-only sentence; `not_household_editor` → "Only a household adult can edit this household"; `invalid_payload` → "Something in the form is not valid").
5. **Edit / add person** `app/(app)/household/person/[id].tsx` (`[id] = 'new'` for create; `src/features/household/PersonEdit.tsx`): fields first/last/preferred name, sex, birthdate (masked) + `birthdate_visibility` (explainer: "Month and day only" default; "the fellowship never sees the year" — decision 2), marital status (the five enum values), role limited to **Child / Other** for non-admins (`allowedRolesForNonAdmin`; the RPC raises `household_role_not_allowed` otherwise — show only those two plus a note "Head of house and spouse are set from the household screen"), `directory_listed` switch, contacts, photo (`PhotoPicker`). Non-admins never see `congregation_status`, `member_since`, `youth_override`, `deceased_on`, `user_id` controls — `field_not_editable` should be unreachable; map it to "You may not change that field" anyway. Create sends `{ org_id, household_id, ... }`; edit sends `{ id, ... }`. "Contacts only" mode (own row, not an adult) shows exactly the contact fields from `editableFieldsFor`. Delete person is NOT offered on mobile (admins do it on the web) — say so in the UI footer.
6. **Head of house** (decision 6) `src/features/household/HeadOfHouse.tsx` on the My household screen: picker over the household's adults (`household_role in ('head','spouse')` or `isAdult(p, settings, asOf)`); on change, exactly like 5.1a's two-call sequence: first `savePerson({ id: currentHead, household_role: <'spouse' | 'other'> })` (ask with a two-option dialog "Spouse / Other" what the previous head becomes), then `savePerson({ id: newHead, household_role: 'head' })`; if the second call fails re-run the first with `household_role: 'head'` to restore, then surface the error. **Known conflict to handle**: 1.3b's `save_person` rule says non-admins may only set `child|other` on others, which blocks a household adult from designating a head; decision 6 says household adults may. Try the calls; when the RPC raises `household_role_not_allowed`, show "Only a directory administrator can change the head of house right now — ask your church" and record in HANDOFF "Deviations from plan" that 1.3b blocks decision 6 for households; the fix (a household adult may move `head` between adults of their own household, through an atomic `set_head_of_house` RPC) is proposed step 5.8 — leave a `TODO(5.8): replace with the atomic set_head_of_house RPC (proposed follow-up migration)` comment. Do not edit `9999_init.sql`.
7. **Privacy screen** `app/(app)/household/privacy.tsx` (`src/features/household/PrivacyScreen.tsx`): an explainer card first — who sees what at each level (congregation: everything the family lists incl. birthday month/day and, if chosen, the year; fellowship: names, address, phones, emails, photos, birthday month/day, no years, adults only unless you opt children in; leaders: everything plus leader notes; "You can hide your family from your own congregation too" — decision 1). Three switches: "Hide from our congregation" (`hide_from_congregation`), "Hide from other churches in the fellowship" (`hide_from_fellowship`), "Show our children to the fellowship" (`show_children_in_fellowship`, disabled with explanation when hidden from the fellowship). Context lines when `settings.directory_share_with_fellowship === false` ("Your church does not share with a fellowship, so this switch has no effect today") or `directory_share_in_congregation === false`. "Save" → `setHouseholdPrivacy(db, { hh: householdId, hide_fell, hide_cong, show_children })` — household adults may move any direction; the RPC stamps `privacy_confirmed_*`. Non-adults see the switches read-only with "Only a household adult (head of house or spouse) can change these". Map `privacy_direction_not_allowed` (cannot happen for an adult; surface generically) and `not_household_editor`. Success toast "Saved — your privacy choices are confirmed". Last line: "Changes are recorded in your church's audit log".
8. **Confirmation flow for admin-created households**: `usePrivacyState(householdId)` (`getPrivacyState`, key `.directory.household(id)` suffixed `'privacy'` — additive `queryKeys.directory.privacy(householdId)` if you prefer); when `privacy_confirmed_at` is null and the member is a household adult, show a persistent banner on Home (`(tabs)/home.tsx`, small edit) and on My household: "A leader added your family to the directory. Your family is hidden from other churches until you review your privacy choices" → "Review" opens `/household/privacy?confirm=1` in confirm mode: the current values are preselected and the primary button reads "Confirm these choices" (calls `set_household_privacy` with the same values — stamping the confirmation). Remember dismissal for 7 days in kv (`privacy_banner_dismissed_at`) but never hide it permanently until confirmed.
9. **Photos (ArrayBuffer)** `src/lib/photo-upload.ts` + `src/features/household/PhotoPicker.tsx`: `ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({ mediaTypes: ['images'], quality: 1, allowsEditing: true, aspect: [1, 1] })` (or `launchCameraAsync`), then `ImageManipulator` to resize the long edge to 1200 px and export JPEG at 0.85 (use the `ImageManipulator.manipulate(uri).resize(...).renderAsync()` / `saveAsync({ format: SaveFormat.JPEG, compress: 0.85 })` API of the installed version — read its typings), then read bytes with `fetch(uri).then(r => r.arrayBuffer())` (DESIGN §7 allows it; this avoids mixing 4.2a's `expo-file-system/legacy` usage with the new `File` API) — **never a Blob on React Native**. Flow: `savePerson`/`saveHousehold` with the planned `photo_path` (`personPhotoPath(orgId, personId, randomUUID())` / `householdPhotoPath(...)` with `expo-crypto` `randomUUID()`) → `supabase.storage.from('directory-photos').upload(path, arrayBuffer, { contentType: 'image/jpeg', upsert: false })` → on failure revert the path with the same RPC (previous value) and show `mapStorageErrorMessage`. Enforce `BUCKETS['directory-photos'].fileSizeLimitBytes` after compression (retry at 0.7 once, then refuse with "This photo is too large"). Invalidate `queryKeys.signedUrl('directory-photos', oldPath)` and the household/person queries. A non-adult may set only their OWN person's photo (own-row rule). Unit-test the pure `planPhotoUpload(kind, ids)` and `pickCompression(bytes)` helpers.
10. **Navigation**: More tab row "My household" (→ `/household`) next to 5.2a's "Directory" row (DESIGN §10); register `household/index`, `household/edit`, `household/person/[id]`, `household/privacy` in the `(app)` stack layout with titles. Add `/household` and `/household/privacy` to the `parseAppLink` allow-list (4.1b) if it filters paths.
11. **Docs**: `docs/MEDIA.md` — a "Directory photos (mobile)" section (picker → manipulator → ArrayBuffer → upload; 10 MiB from `BUCKETS`; orphan sweep). `docs/RLS.md` — "Mobile self-service (5.2b)" paragraph listing which screen calls which RPC, the own-row contacts rule, and the head-of-house conflict if you hit it. `docs/MOBILE_BUILD.md` — the new photo permission strings AND a "My household" section in the founder's device checklist containing the Manual verify steps below verbatim.

## Constraints
- Reads only through `directory_households`, `directory_persons`, `org_directory_info`, `organization_settings`; never the `persons`/`households` base tables, never the leader-notes tables. Writes only via `save_household`, `save_person`, `set_household_privacy`. The mobile app holds only the `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` values (`EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL`) — no elevated keys, no server code.
- Mobile native dependency versions come only from `npx expo install`; `react` stays `catalog:` (19.2.3). Do not add `react-hook-form` or web-only packages. Do not import from `apps/web`.
- Do not build calendars/events (5.3b), join codes (5.6), CSV import, delete-person on mobile, or any migration. Do not change `9999_init.sql`; never `supabase db push`/`db reset`.
- Never persist signed URLs or photo bytes in the query cache; never log personal data. No model identifiers, no secrets.

## Verify
- `pnpm turbo lint typecheck test` → every task succeeds; `rules.test.ts` (`canEditHousehold`, `editableFieldsFor`, `allowedRolesForNonAdmin`) and `photo-upload.test.ts` pass.
- `cd apps/mobile && npx expo-doctor` → all checks pass (or the same known exclusions 4.1a recorded); `npx expo export --platform android` → bundle written with no errors; `pnpm --filter mobile typecheck` clean.
- `grep -rn "new Blob\|from('persons')\|from('households')\|leader_notes\|react-hook-form\|DIRECTORY_PHOTO_MAX_BYTES" apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/app apps/mobile/package.json` → no output.
- `grep -n "expo-image-picker\|expo-image-manipulator" apps/mobile/package.json` → versions present, matching `npx expo install --check` (no drift reported).
- Manual (founder's device with a preview build, or after 4.5): sign in as a household head of an admin-created household → Home shows the review banner → Privacy → "Confirm these choices" → banner gone and `households.privacy_confirmed_at` set (SQL Editor); turn "Hide from our congregation" on → another member no longer sees the household in Our congregation but the family still sees itself under My household; edit the household address → visible to the congregation; add a child (role Child) → appears under People; upload a person photo (row in `storage.objects` under `<org>/persons/<id>/`); as a non-adult member of the household, open My household → only the own row is editable and only its contact fields; try the head-of-house picker as a household adult → either it works or the "ask your church" message appears (record which in HANDOFF).

## Finish
- `HANDOFF.md`: feature table "Directory (households, persons, photos, privacy override)" Mobile UI → done (5.2a + 5.2b); State checklist; "Version pins worth remembering" with the `expo-image-picker` / `expo-image-manipulator` versions installed; "Deviations from plan" for the head-of-house conflict (whether `save_person` refused a household adult — 5.8 input) and any additive `@church/db` helper (`queryKeys.directory.privacy`).
- Tick step 5.2b in `docs/TODO.md`; write `session_log.md`; commit `feat(mobile): household self-service, privacy confirmation, directory photos`; push `main` (or the branch I named).
- If anything in the plan proves impossible or wrong, do the closest correct thing, record it in HANDOFF.md under "Deviations from plan", and report it in your final message.

A household adult edits household details (anniversary prefilled from `anniversary_display`) and adds/edits people through `save_household` / `save_person` using Paper inputs + `safeParse` (no `react-hook-form`); the role picker offers only Child/Other for others; a non-adult member can edit only their own contact fields; delete is not offered on mobile; error keys (`not_household_editor`, `household_role_not_allowed`, `field_not_editable`, `organization_suspended`) map to readable text.
